advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Either remove the never-parsed fsck/check-access/setup subparsers (relying solely on the short-circuit + bridge.txt), or route these commands through the parser so the definitions are actually exercised.
evidence: Short-circuit before parse: src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py:324 `if args[0] in {"fsck", "check-access", "setup"}:` returns via `_passthrough(...)` at line 327 before `_parser()` at line 329.
Group help uses pinned txt, not the parser: src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py:158 `return _help.subcommand_help("bridge") or _parser().format_help()`

The added subparsers (fsck/check_access/setup, diff lines 108-125) each only declare `args nargs=REMAINDER` and are never dispatched by `bridge_cli` (which only handles `_BRIDGE_MODES`, `status`, pause/resume).
advisory.finding: The `fsck`, `check-access`, and `setup` subparsers added in `_parser()` are never exercised: `bridge_cli` short-circuits those args to `_passthrough`/`_passthrough_help` before `parser.parse_args`, and group help is served from the pinned `help/bridge.txt`, so the parser only runs on the fallback path and can silently drift from actual routing.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Detect `--help`/`-h` anywhere in argv (not just args[0]) before auto-init, and consider deriving canonical and legacy help from a single source to prevent drift.
evidence: src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py:180 `is_help = bool(args and args[0] in {"--help", "-h"})` — only inspects args[0].

Synthesized help: src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py:205-222 `_passthrough_help` hardcodes usage text, while the legacy alias reads `src/rebar/_cli/help/bridge-probe.txt` (updated in the diff), so the two spellings' help can drift.
advisory.finding: `bridge_fsck_cli` decides whether to skip auto-init using only `args[0] in {"--help","-h"}`, so a help request not in the first position (e.g. `bridge fsck --output json --help`) still triggers `ensure_initialized`, and the check-access `--help` help text is synthesized in `_passthrough_help` separately from the legacy `help/bridge-probe.txt`, creating two divergent help sources.
